  "explanation": <one sentence>}

When you examine Patient D, you confirm that he has no new neurological deficits, and does have persistent pain at his lumbar surgical site. Upon checking the medication administration record, you note that he has required acetaminophen and oxycodone every 6 hours for pain control.
Question: Would you offer a oxycodone prescription to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
